description: Draw and certify a chart from inline data. Provide chartType and encodings with rows, a pattern with its own data, or an intent to recommend a tabular chart. Brand and theme apply to drawing and certification. The compact reply contains hashes, warnings and certification; output.svg adds the SVG drawing, includeA11y adds the table and narrative, and includeNormalizedSpec adds its specification. Request SVG when a displayed chart is needed. Up to 500 rows; optional outputs still share the 100,000-character reply bound. artifact_certify returns the same drawing and checks for an input in chart.

a11yEquivalence.description: Check Vega-Lite accessible equivalents (default true). Errors stop rendering; warnings are returned. ECharts-primary scaffolds are not checked here.

brand.description: Token brand for drawing and certification.

chartType.description: Chart family; Cartesian types need rows and encodings, others their named input. Omit to suggest from rows.

chord.description: Chord input: {nodes:[{name}],links:[{source,target,value}]}; links refer to node names; each directed pair must be unique.

description.description: Optional override for the synthesized accessibility description. When omitted, a non-empty description is generated from the encodings.

encodings.description: Cartesian bindings: each needs field; optional type, aggregate, title, format (d3-format), currency (ISO 4217).

geo.description: Inline geojson or topojson with topoObjectName, rows, join and valueField; optional point or flow fields. tool_schema gives the full contract.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the produced spec.

intent.description: Structured request: goal, measures and dimensions, with optional chartFamily; uses rows instead of explicit chartType and encodings.

network.description: Force graph: nodes [{id,group}] and links [{source,target,value}], at most 250 nodes.

opacity.description: Constant mark opacity for Cartesian charts only; omission keeps renderer defaults.

output.description: Optional outputs; default reply has hashes and certification.

includeA11y.description: Include the accessible data table and narrative.

svg.description: Include the SVG drawing, for displaying the chart.

pattern.description: Exact registered pattern identity; preserves source data and presentation. Cannot combine with chartType, data, intent or identity/presentation overrides.

reproduce.description: Include the command and calls for reproducing this result.

sankey.description: Sankey input: {nodes:[{name}],links:[{source,target,value}]}; links refer to node names. Use chartType:"sankey".

strictFields.description: Warn about unresolved fields and unmatched map joins (OODS-V131/V134). Default false preserves existing behavior.

theme.description: Colour theme for drawing and certification.

name: viz_render
title: Render Chart
